reconfigure.title: Update Everlights Bridge
reconfigure.description: Update the host if your bridge's IP address has changed.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the bridge.
error.local_control_removed: This bridge's firmware (B5010 or newer) no longer allows local control, so lights cannot be controlled from Home Assistant. Everlights moved control to their cloud.

local_control_removed.title: Everlights bridge no longer allows local control
local_control_removed.description: The bridge's firmware (B5010 or newer) removed the local control API and moved control to the Everlights cloud. Lights can no longer be controlled from Home Assistant; only the signal and status sensors still work. This integration will resume control automatically if Everlights restores local access.
